def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    t1.neg_()
    v1 = t2.to(t2.dtype)
    v2 = torch.select_scatter(t2, v1.select(0, 3), 0, 3)
    v3 = v2.transpose(1, 2)
    idx4 = torch.tensor([2], device=v2.device)
    v2.index_add_(0, idx4, t2.narrow(0, 0, 1))
    idx5 = torch.tensor([1], device=v1.device)
    v1[idx5] = 1
    v6 = v1.clone()
    return (v3, t1, v6, t1, v3, lst, dct)
